outcomeSummary: A clear miss: the period after July 2024 brought reasoning models (o3, GPT-5), mainstream coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and scientific milestones such as Claude's November 2026 Riemann-hypothesis-related formal-proof work in Lean — accelerating capability, not a plateau.

outcomeSummary: Correct on prices: both labs raised enterprise and priority pricing in mid-2025, moved business customers to token-based billing in early 2026, and hiked consumer plans; neither has collapsed yet, though both still burn billions per quarter.

outcomeSummary: Largely borne out: OpenAI and Anthropic jacked up enterprise pricing in mid-2025, shifted customers to token billing in Q1 2026, and downstream buyers (Replit, Cursor, Uber, T-Mobile) publicly reined in or re-priced token spend — the pass-through cascade Ed predicted.
